name: podolsk-print-tilda-site
description: Compillable js and css assets for podolsk-print site
author: lilliputten@gmail.com

scripts.format: echo --Run prettier-- && prettier --write --cache . | grep -v -e cached -e unchanged || true
scripts.eslint-debug: echo --Lint sources with eslint in debug mode-- && cross-env DEBUG=eslint:cli-engine eslint --debug .
scripts.eslint-fix: echo --Lint and auto-fix sources with eslint-- && eslint --fix .
scripts.lint-all: echo --Run all pre-commit check-ups-- && npm-run-all type-check eslint-check stylelint && echo --All check-ups passed--
scripts.check-all: echo --Run all pre-commit check-ups-- && npm-run-all format-quick lint-all && echo --All checks passed--
scripts.build-and-publish: echo --Build and publish-- && npm-run-all build publish
scripts.publish: echo --Publish build /posix commands and uplevel utils branch are used/-- && sh ./.utils/publish.sh
scripts.build-inject: echo --Create and inject all assets /webpack/-- && cross-env INJECT=true webpack
scripts.build-dev: echo --Create all assets in debug mode /webpack/-- && cross-env DEV=true webpack
scripts.build-inject-dev: echo --Create all assets in debug mode /webpack/-- && cross-env DEV=true INJECT=true webpack
scripts.watch-build-inject: echo --Watch and inject all assets /webpack/-- && cross-env INJECT=true webpack --watch
scripts.watch-build-dev: echo --Watch all assets in debug mode /webpack/-- && cross-env DEV=true webpack --watch
scripts.watch-build-inject-dev: echo --Watch all assets in debug mode /webpack/-- && cross-env DEV=true INJECT=true webpack --watch
scripts.dev: echo --Run all dev server-- && cross-env DEV=true webpack serve --mode development
scripts.clear-build: echo --Clear build folder-- && rimraf -I -g build/* && echo Build folder has been cleaned
scripts.clear-build-dev: echo --Clear debug build folder-- && rimraf -I -g build-dev/* && echo Debug build folder has been cleaned
scripts.clear-cache: echo --Clear caches-- && rimraf node_modules/.cache && echo Cleared webpack cache
scripts.optimize-assets: echo --Optimize public assets-- && pnpm svgo public/assets
